meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Google Chat 与用户聊天，支持群组空间和私信，并能回复线程消息。
howto.when: 当你在 Google Chat 中与机器人对话时触发，或者通过 /manage-channels 命令将频道连接到代理组后使用。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日程安排。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Google Chat 回复你。

say.text: 在团队空间里发一条公告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can chat with users via Google Chat, supporting group spaces and direct messages, and can reply in threads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you talk to the bot in Google Chat, or after connecting the channel to an agent group via /manage-channels.

say_en.note: Claude will reply via Google Chat.

say_en.text: Post an announcement in the team space.
say_en.note: Claude will send a message to the specified Google Chat space.
